scripts.test: npm run test:delete:db ; db-migrate db:create storefront_test ; db-migrate --env test up ; npm run tsc ; ENV=test jasmine-ts ; db-migrate db:drop storefront_test
scripts.setup:dev: db-migrate up --env dev && npm run seed:dev
scripts.setup:prod: db-migrate up --env prod && npm run seed
scripts.db:recreate: db-migrate db:drop storefront_dev && db-migrate db:create storefront_dev && db-migrate up --env dev && npm run seed:dev
scripts.db:recreate:test: db-migrate db:drop storefront_test && db-migrate db:create storefront_test && db-migrate up --env test
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:recreate && npm run db:recreate:test
